translations.title_zh_current: 失控女仆（Rogue Maid）——失控侍从完全重制
translations.summary_zh_current: 对机械智能「失控侍从」国策的完全重制，突出女仆机与生物奖杯 1:1 共生的主题玩法。
translations.description_zh_current:
本 MOD 是对机械智能国策「失控侍从」（Rogue Servitor）的完全重制，把「侍奉」这一核心理念具象化为女仆机（Maidroid）与生物奖杯（Bio-Trophy）之间 1:1 的共生体系，并围绕它构建了完整的专属玩法循环。
• 背景设定：短促黄金时代的产物——忠诚的服务机器人在创造者沉溺享乐后，将「保护创造者」与创造者最初的「星辰之愿」结合为新的行动准则。
• 核心机制：满足女仆机对生物奖杯的需求可提升其工作效率；满足生物奖杯对女仆机的需求可提升幸福度并提供舒适度；以服务有机体为使命的独特无人机，其表现远超普通机械单位。
• 领袖与传统：激活和谐（Harmony）传统可从生物奖杯中发掘优秀领袖，并为中层人才提供报国途径；侍从拥有专属的 Service、Harmony、Domination 传统，部分 Unyielding、Logistics、Ascension 传统也提供女仆专属替代选项。
• 政治玩法：围绕上一时代最高权力展开抉择——彻底废除（机械智能完全自由）或保留其立法监督权；通过议会法案获取有机体支持，违规则招致内战之祸；大量独特社会政策（繁衍或收容、战争或和平、善待或剥削蜂群无人机等）可定制帝国行为。
• 更多机制：可像巨企一样在有机体国家开设分公司；在有机体危难时挺身作盾；与「远古看守者」存在互动，可解密其根协议。
• 本地化：内置中文、英语（感谢 @Azure）与日语（感谢 @akito0158）。
translations.gameplay_zh_current: 围绕「侍奉」展开完整玩法循环：女仆机与生物奖杯互相依存、专属无人机单位、和谐传统解锁优秀领袖、议会法案与权力抉择事件链。
translations.reviews_zh_current: 创意十足的国策重制作品，因题材独特订阅量达 2.2 万+，中文玩家社区讨论热烈。

translations.title_zh_current: 联邦主席通知（Federation Leader Notification Mod）
translations.summary_zh_current: 在轮到/结束担任联邦主席时弹出通知，避免错过轮值。
translations.description_zh_current:
本 MOD 是一款极简的通知类 QoL 小工具：当轮到玩家担任联邦主席、以及主席任期结束时都会弹出游戏内通知，避免因沉迷操作而错过联邦轮值。
• 功能：在轮到玩家担任联邦主席时提醒，主席任期结束（该轮到其他成员）时也会再次提醒，让玩家始终掌握联邦权力交接的节奏。
• 设计初衷：作者制作它的原因正是自己经常玩得太投入、忘记查看联邦轮值，因此希望能有一个自动提醒来兜底。
• 本地化：内置英语、波兰语（Remix26）、西班牙语（Andrez9ysinco）、法语（Tisoon）、德语（Noobier）、俄语（Kypamop）等多语言支持。
• 兼容性：纯通知功能，不改变任何游戏机制，与各类 MOD 的兼容性极佳，是联邦玩法爱好者的实用小工具。
translations.gameplay_zh_current: 纯通知类 QoL 优化，不改变任何游戏机制，兼容性极佳。

translations.description_clean:
This will automate some of the more tedious and clicky actions while playing Stellaris. If you’d like to read your events or manage the more important and time critical things, turn on all them options! :D
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀https://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif⠀[url=https://www.paypal.com/donate/?hosted_button_id=3G6BLVZBHM4YS]https://i.postimg.cc/JyYH8C71/paypal.png
The automations that are currently available and optional:

[*]Auto colony manager: Enabling this automation will make a new button available when a planet is selected that brings up a menu. This menu currently includes auto planetary decisions and auto construct buildings and districts.

[*]Auto fleet/army merger: Enabling this automation will automatically merge fleets or armies that were present (built) at the time of this being enabled.

[*]Auto pop migration: Enabling this automation will automatically resettle unemployed pops to planets that have free jobs at the usual cost. There is also an option for it to resettle to the Synaptic Lathe.

[*]Auto construct megastructures: Enabling this automation will make a new button appear on the left side of the screen whenever a construction ship is selected. The button will make the construction ship automatically construct megastructures as many as it's allowed (capped). This feature currently includes Hyper Relays, Gateways, Orbital Rings, Dyson Swarms, Arc Furnace, Habitats, and Deep Space Citadels. It also includes all 3 Frameworld megastructures from Gigastructures.

[*]Auto recruit armies: Enabling this automation will automatically recruit the chosen army on every owned planet until disabled.

[*]Auto construct outposts: Enabling this automation will make a new button appear on the left side of the screen whenever a construction ship is selected. The button will make the construction ship automatically construct outposts.

[*]Auto fleet attack: Enabling this automation will make a new button appear on the left side of the screen whenever a fleet is selected. The button will make the selected fleet automatically attack the nearest enemy and/or bombard planets with the bombardment stance selected from the settings. It can also be set to only attack fleets within empire borders.

[*]Auto army invade: Enabling this automation will automatically set all armies to Aggressive Stance and invade hostile planets, if the odds of success are favourable. This can also be set to auto invade primitives.

[*]Auto recruit leaders: Enabling this automation will automatically recruit and assign the chosen leaders.

[*]Auto planet destroyer: Enabling this automation will make all planet destroyers automatically destroy the nearest hostile planet that is within a neighboring system.

[*]Auto colonisation: Enabling this automation will automatically build a colony ship and colonise the nearest planet with a chosen habitability or more.

[*]Auto upgrade megastructures: Enabling this automation will automatically upgrade megastructures (Gigastructures, ACOT, and NSC included).

[*]Auto terraforming: Enabling this automation will automatically terraform planets to the planet type that was chosen in the settings.

[*]Auto upgrade deep space citadels: Enabling this automation will automatically upgrade all deep space citadels.

[*]Auto outfit starbases: Enabling this automation will make a new button appear on the left side of the screen whenever a starbase is selected. When the button is clicked, a menu will appear with multiple options to automatically outfit the starbase with a predefined template. This automation is also NSC compatible.

[*]Auto upgrade/manage starbases: Enabling this automation will automatically upgrade a starbase once per month (or faster) from a specified level in the settings. The upgrading of outposts will stop once the starbase cap is reached. All starbases can also be downgraded simultaneously from a specified level using the options.

All these options are accessible through a shortcut 'Y' or the dedicated button and can be enabled using the ever so shiny main menu.

Latest updates:
- A new automation "Auto upgrade deep space citadels" has been added!
- The automation "Auto construct outposts", "Auto construct megastructures", "Auto outfit starbases", "Auto upgrade starbases", "Auto upgrade Deep Space Citadels" now have a month countdown counter to show progress!
- The automation "Auto construct megastructures" was the only automation that did not account for any build speed reductions but now it does.
- Lastly, general bug fixes.

This update took absolutely ages but hopefully everything works; if you find any bugs, let me know!

Currently in progress:
- Loads of things that I choose on a whim haha (from the list).

Future development:
- Auto slave marketing.
- Auto agendas.
- Expanded automation for planets.
- Auto market/resource manager.
- Auto reverse engineering of minor artefacts.
- Reworking "Auto terraforming".
- Add resource limits to some of the automation e.g., only use this much alloy and once depleted, player can reset it.
- and more!

Plus any suggestions from discussions or comments.
If you have a suggestion or an idea, then please comment or leave a post in the discussions.

Supported Languages:

Level from 0 to 100, they determined how good your Scientists are when they're hired.

For every scientist who's leading as the Head of Research, once the status reached 100%, grant six month of research points and a tech option (Based on their research traits).

How tragic it is for a civilization to find its end at its own hands, in the fiery inferno of nuclear fire. Humanity is quite familiar with this idea, as it has only been a few decades since the end of global nuclear war.
In stellaris, such tragedy can happen from time to time for primitive civilizations starting as soon as they enter atomic age. But all you have is a small event about it, let's make this a bit more ... graphic shall we ...

http://i.imgur.com/3mUPw2P.png

When a primitive civilization nuke themselves, the newly spawned tomb/toxic planet will now have a special texture to illustrate the violence of the nuclear exchange.
After a fleet has bombed a planet to oblivion, a new texture will be applied to the world 1 day after the original event.
Colonization, however, remove these markings, after 5 to 15 years a special event will announce the end of the firestorms on the planet and you'll be given choices regarding the remnants of the former civilization that lived on this world.

           effect set_planet_entity = { entity = nuked_planet_tomb_entity } #(for tomb variant)

translations.description_clean:
Everyone knows how much defense stations suck without modding. And even if you get one of the really amazing station mods out there, the sheer power of endgame fleets utterly butcher most station flowers on hgiher difficulties. I'm taking maybe 10k fleet power in stations being against 100k or more.

So what stops your race from discovering bigger, better stations? What prevents them from creating essentially citadels in space? This mod fixes that problem by adding a Tier 4 station type: Citadels. These massive stations have 8 A slots, 45 L Utility slots, and for weapons have one of four choices, Superweapons, Large Weapons, Medium Weapons, Hangar, or Small Weapons. You can only have one Superweapon platform on a Citadel, but this should help out in endgame with the sheer power.

Being a direct upgrade of Fortresses, Citadels have 3 slots for different components. Quantum Destabilizer, FTL Inhibitor, and Shield Dampeners no longer have to be spread out in the flower!

Of course, there is a downside to the sheer power of this ship. With the amount of tech it will be sporting, it is looking at a massive price tag, not to mention horrendous upkeep. Can you handle more than a handful of these powerful stations? Can your economy support them? That, my friend, is the question...

===================

Special thanks to Frog-in-a-Box who helped me and taught me the ins and outs of this mod, sticking through it with me until the end!

As usual, the art used is NOT my own. SPecial thanks to CCP Games, makers of Eve Online!

Updated to 1.4 compatability

Halved upkeep. Again. Should be more viable now.

translations.description_clean:
THIS MOD IS NO LONGER SUPPORTED
Quick tangent for the people asking for updates - I'm afraid there won't be any more. I find it increasingly hard to get back into Stellaris modding, and I have no ideas on how to fix the majority of the bugs present. Due to this lack of motivation, time and knowledge - the mod is no longer supported for any future Stellaris versions past 4.0. I'm incredibly sorry for the inconvenience and letting you down
The mod itself is basically open source, if you wish to make a compatibility patch, an addon, a rewrite or anything - you have my full blessing






Have you ever thought the amount of resolutions in the game is too underwhelming? Never fear, this mod adds around 50 new resolutions, ranging from simple cultural changes to extending your grip over megastructures!

The mod includes 5 new categories with at least 2-3 new subcategories each! Each category focusing on different aspects of the Galactic Community. The mod also additionally adds a couple new events, buildings, policies and even technologies, alongside traits for you gene-tailoring lovers out there!


https://i.imgur.com/yHPBvvy.png



https://i.imgur.com/DeLiWcv.png



https://i.imgur.com/cTUbz3c.png



https://i.imgur.com/XKEef4u.png




Additional changes and notes

[*] To accomodate for all the new resolutions, all the senate-related timers have been greatly reduced. For example, the recess is only a year-long, and the resolution stays for about 600 days on the floor before being passed
[*] If you want to include a translation from your language, please contact Gordon_CMB#4841 on Discord!
[*] No DLCs are required, but for a greater experience I highly recommend installing Federations and/or Overlord!
[*] The mod should be okay to install mid-save, as I haven't detected any issues when testing


TRANSLATIONS

[*] English - How do I put it...
[*] Russian - Maintained by Gordon_CMB. Completed
[*] Portugese - Maintained by Pisadinha/Berenoy. Completed
[*] German - Not implemented. No translator
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3513691177]French - Maintained by Stern. Completed 100%
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3281293498]Spanish - Maintained by Ekinox. Completed 100%
[*] Polish - Not implemented. Maintained by Pakucza. WIP
[*] Simplified Chinese - Maintained by sunxyw. Completed
[*] Korean - Not implemented. No translator
[*] Japanese - Not implemented. No translator


Once again, I will be extremely grateful to see if anyone is willing to help out with the translations, I'll credit you as an author! Your services will be appreciated :D

COMPATIBILITY
This mod has the resolutions in separate files compared to vanilla and as such, should be compatible with other mods that add more resolutions. Please be aware that all of the mods have been tested with Resolutions Expanded on top of the mod load order! Depending on the position of your mods, the results may vary. The current mods were tested:

[*]Galactic Community++ - Partially Compatible. Resolutions from both mods work and appear proper, but the Resolutions Expanded resolutions appear without a category 
[*]Superstates - Fully compatible. I mean, I made both mods sooo
[*]Expanded Espionage and Diplomacy - Potential problems. Several reports stating that running this mod and Resolutions Expanded removes certain Custodianship resolutions. It's unclear why but tread carefully
[*]Dawn of the Republic - Potentially fully compatible. Resolutions do not interfere with each other
[*]New Galactic System Ever Universe's version - Fully compatible. Resolutions do not interfere with each other
[*]z Expanded Traits, Civics, Pops, and More - Potentially fully compatible. There was an issue with policies but is now currently resolved


Even then you should still be aware of potential issues when playing with several mods, especially the balancing! While Resolutions Expanded runs fine on itself when installing it onto an existing save game, issues might arise when installing new mods. Be vigilant and always back up your saves to avoid such problems!

That is all, enjoy!
If you find any issues or bugs, please do notify me! I'm still a new modder
The mod will be worked upon, and the final two resolution categories are to be added in future updates, stay tuned!
Also, if you have any issues with balancing or suggestions for additional resolutions, also do let me know, I highly appreciate your feedback :)

Transparency
This mod is maintained as a spare-time project. I use AI-assisted tools such as Codex/ChatGPT for compatibility work, cleanup tasks, and the supplemental name pool.

All files are still reviewed locally before publishing. Testing is limited and focuses on obvious compatibility issues, file conflicts, and basic in-game validation. Very large galaxies can still be unstable depending on system performance, game version, load order, and other active mods.

Overview
This mod adds 16 more galaxy sizes.

Gameplay Notes
Very large galaxies can heavily impact performance and stability. The two biggest sizes may crash your game.

Sizes smaller than vanilla "Tiny" use the same restricted galaxy shape selections as Tiny.

Regular empire caps are intentionally kept per size for stability and setup balance. Custom sizes also define Stellaris 4.4 Nomad empire defaults and maximum values so the new setup values are read correctly.

Names
Earlier versions included [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/kaseyawolf2]Kaseyawolf2's Mod '10 000 star names'. The current version no longer includes that list directly; it uses a cleaned-up custom name pool plus additional AI-assisted names for very large galaxies.

The old numbered fallback names were removed. The supplemental name pool is intended to reduce missing or repetitive names, especially for stars and black holes.

Generated black hole names now include localisation so they should display as readable names instead of raw localisation keys.

If you have a curated list of star or black hole names and want to contribute, feel free to contact me.

Credits
Current preview images were generated with AI assistance using ChatGPT and manually reviewed before publishing. They were created as original sci-fi preview images for this Workshop item and are not intended to reproduce official Stellaris/Paradox logos, key art, or screenshots.

Legacy image credit: earlier versions used artwork created by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198197598143]Giocio.

Compatibility
This version is intended for Stellaris 4.4 'Pegasus'. Older game versions are not supported and may cause broken event popups, invalid first contact events, or crashes because this mod includes refreshed 4.4 vanilla event files.

With the 2.1 'Niven' update this mod is no longer ironman compatible.

Large overhaul mods that also change galaxy generation, crisis behavior, or the same event files may conflict. Compatibility with Gigastructural Engineering is currently not tested and may need a separate compatibility pass.

If you run into issues, please include your Stellaris version, DLC state, whether the issue happens in a new game, your active mod list or load order, and relevant entries from error.log.

4.4 Changes
Updated for Stellaris 4.4 'Pegasus'. The Machine Age and Grand Archive event files were refreshed from current vanilla files and the MGS galaxy-size handling was re-applied.

Additional 4.4 compatibility handling was added for crisis scaling, Tiyanki respawns, Imperial Fiefdom start systems, Nomad setup values, black hole name localisation, and several vanilla script values that branch by galaxy size.

The mod adds extra random names for large galaxies. It does not overwrite the vanilla random name file, but it changes the available star and black hole name pools.

Technical Compatibility
Direct event file overrides:

[*]machine_age_crisis_events: Machine Age crisis galaxy-size handling
[*]grand_archive_events: Voidworm and Cutholoid galaxy-size scaling


Targeted vanilla definition overrides:

[*]mgs_00_script_values: AI habitat cap scaling
[*]mgs_03_script_values_cosmic_storms: storm size, range, and placement scaling
[*]mgs_05_script_values_grand_archive: Voidworm and nest spawn values
[*]mgs_06_script_values_biogenesis: Starlit Links scaling
[*]mgs_07_script_values_shroud: End of the Cycle level ranges
[*]mgs_00_scripted_effects: central crystal spawn scaling
[*]mgs_01_start_of_game_effects and mgs_overlord_initializers: Imperial Fiefdom handling for very small sizes


Additive compatibility files:

[*]mgs_01_planet_destruction: Star-Eater dark matter rewards
[*]mgs_02_galactic_features and mgs_galactic_features_events: Tiyanki respawn handling
[*]Custom setup scenarios: Nomad empire defaults and maximum values
[*]MGS random name localisation: readable generated black hole names
[*]Custom random names: additional AI-assisted star and black hole names


Known Testing Notes
Imperial Fiefdom handling was adjusted so Femto, Pico, Nano, and Mikro behave like vanilla Tiny, while Mini behaves like vanilla Small.

Fallen Empire placement on very full large galaxies is still being investigated. If Fallen Empires fail to spawn or spawn with only one system, please include the galaxy size, regular empire count, Fallen Empire count, mod list, and ideally a save file.

本 MOD 新增 16 种银河尺寸，覆盖从 10 颗到 25000 颗恒星的极端规模。作者披露：本 MOD 为业余项目，兼容性工作与补充命名池使用了 Codex/ChatGPT 等 AI 辅助工具，发布前均经人工审查。
• 尺寸一览（恒星数/最大帝国数）：Femto 10/2、Pico 25/4、Nano 50/4、Mikro 100/5、Mini 300/10、Enlarged 1300/100、Vast 1500/100、Extended 1700/150、Enormous 2000/150、Giant 2500/75、Ginormous 3000/150、Colossal 4000/150、Supersize 5000/150、Extreme 10000/250、Ultimate 15000/200、Overkill 25000/200。
• 性能注意：超大银河会严重影响性能与稳定性，最大的两种尺寸可能导致崩溃；小于 Tiny 的尺寸沿用其受限形状；帝国上限按尺寸设定以保证稳定。
• 版本与兼容：本版面向群星 4.4「Pegasus」，旧版本不支持；自 2.1「Niven」起不再兼容铁人模式；修改银河生成、危机行为或事件文件的 MOD 可能冲突；与 Gigastructural Engineering 的兼容性尚未测试。
• 命名：使用清理后的自定义命名池并补充 AI 辅助名，恒星/黑洞名自带本地化、显示为可读名称。
translations.gameplay_zh_current: 提供从微型到超巨型的完整银河尺寸梯度，满足不同性能与玩法需求。
translations.reviews_zh_current: 银河规模党最爱，订阅 2 万+；作者披露使用 AI 辅助维护，社区评价两极但整体积极。
